learning_outcomes.text: Safely carry out a range of basic Laboratory procedures using standard processes.
Process data collected during an experiment, use CAD tools for design and simulation, and produce a formal written report with conclusions.

Identify and reflect upon the following aspects of self-awareness in respect of personal development and career planning: strengths and weaknesses, motivations and values, ability to work with others.
Work as a team to gather data analyse the results and discuss the benefits and issues of various affordable, renewable energy systems.

syllabus_topics: Use of Instruments and taking measurement
Introduction to research skills of Professional body requirements
Keeping a logbook to record notes, Measurements and observations

assessment_methods.method: Future Focus e-learning task (Personal Development - Reflective Practice Self- Assessment Activity)

assessment_rules: The assessment includes an online assessment (online quiz) and a Professional Practice test. The Written Report is an Academic Paper for one of the lab experiments and is a pass/fail component, with questions answered in an online quiz. Students will also do fieldwork activities. A mini project constructing a working product is a pass/fail activity for groups, followed by an online quiz. Pass/fail components must be completed to avoid negating associated assessment.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
